title: 1994 Air Force holographic projector concept

tellings.quote: In 1999, reporter William Arkin wrote an article about a 1994 Air Force concept for a holographic projector,

plain: In 1994 the Air Force is said to have drawn up a concept for a holographic projector, a device that would throw three-dimensional images into the sky. Michels tells this from an article by the reporter William Arkin, published in 1999, which he says described the concept. He brings it up in an episode about a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor, because such a device, if it worked, could make people see objects that were not there.
